## Cloudflare valuation questioned after strong results and AI service momentum lift expectations

NET's strong print validates the AI-edge monetization thesis, but valuation tension means the stock may reward thesis holders less than fresh buyers — worth tracking whether the question-mark framing broadens into analyst downgrades.

- Cloudflare reported results that exceeded expectations, reinforcing its AI-native edge platform thesis
- AI service growth is cited as a lift to the near-term revenue outlook
- Coverage poses the question of whether the stock is fully priced given the positive setup
- Single-outlet piece; framing is valuation/sentiment rather than a new fundamental disclosure
